event_description:
Interested in getting a set of high-quality solo portrait shots of your Touhou cosplay? Come over to our Solo Photo Studio, where one of our talented cosplay photographers will be able to help!

**Note!** Walk-ins are allowed for all Solo Photo Studio timeslots, but attendees are highly encouraged to make a reservation in advance; attendees with reservations will be prioritized. Please use the below reservations link to get signed up:

The Cosplay Workshop is a new offering at Touhoufest 2026: It will be a series of guided tutorials on various cosplay-related topics.

The sewing section will explore various techniques on how to approach a sewing project including: 

- How to select fabrics for your project, and we will even have fabric samples!
- How to select a sewing machine for your skill level
- How to identify the garments you will need to cosplay a touhou character
- Basics on patterning/designing garments based on your measurements
- Live sewing machine demonstrations

Please let us know if you have any suggestions for topics to cover!
## [Suggestions Form](https://forms.gle/Lxp94yWEvPQuGo6E7)

The Cosplay Workshop is a new offering at Touhoufest 2026: It will be a series of guided tutorials on various cosplay-related topics.

The props, wigs, and makeup section will explore various techniques on how to handle the non-dress related aspects of your cosplay, including:

- Basics on working with EVA Foam for props, as well as brief looks at other prop-making materials 
- How to paint your props 
- Wig basics and live wig cutting demonstrations
- Makeup basics and live makeup demonstrations

Please let us know if you have any suggestions for topics to cover!
## [Suggestions Form](https://forms.gle/Lxp94yWEvPQuGo6E7)

The Cosplay Workshop is a new offering at Touhoufest 2026: It will be a series of guided tutorials on various cosplay-related topics.

The photography section will explore various techniques on how to handle the non-dress related aspects of your cosplay, including:

- How to pose well for a photo as a subject
- How to setup your set/lighting
- How to choose your camera / equipment
- Basics of photo editing

Please let us know if you have any suggestions for topics to cover!
